description: This file is a header file defining interfaces for plugin management within a DM (Device Management) system. It declares functions related to finding, disabling, loading, and freeing plugin objects and their indices.

methods.name: find_entry_obj
methods.description: Finds a specific entry object based on the provided object path.

methods.name: disable_entry_obj
methods.description: Disables a specific entry object using its path and plugin information.

methods.name: disable_entry_leaf
methods.description: Disables a leaf node within an entry object based on its path.

methods.name: get_entry_obj_idx
methods.description: Retrieves the index of the specified entry object.

methods.name: get_entry_leaf_idx
methods.description: Retrieves the index of the specified entry leaf.

methods.name: get_obj_idx
methods.description: Gets the index of the entry object via pointer.

methods.name: get_leaf_idx
methods.description: Gets the index of the entry leaf via pointer.

methods.name: load_plugins
methods.description: Loads plugins into the DM entry object from a specified path.

methods.name: free_plugins
methods.description: Frees resources associated with loaded plugins in the DM entry object.
